built. To determine the model of the Intel GPU, install pciutils-3.14.0 and run lspci -nn | grep -Ei 'VGA|DISPLAY' first. It will output some information about the GPU, including the PCI vendor ID (8086 for Intel) and the PCI device ID. For example, with an Intel Core i5-11300H CPU, the output is 8086:9a49.
